title: Rows
description: The visual rows one logical line is drawn as, top to bottom, each the half-open character range of the line shown on it. Never empty: a line always occupies at least one row. Consecutive ranges are one apart at most, and the character between them is the one the break was spent on, drawn on neither row and still in the line.

start.description: Character index in the line at which this row starts.

end.description: Character index one past the last character on this row. Never before start, and never further than cols past it.
